Looking at the qlang documentation, I'll work through each task systematically, building queries from the examples and laws provided.

H1: /data | filter ~((/active | eq true) !| false) | filter ~((/address/city | type | eq ::string) !| false) | * /name | sort ~(lower)

H2: filter ~((/status | lower | eq "paid") !| false) | * (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2

H3: [/dependencies /devDependencies] | reduce {} ~(union /) | filter ~(startsWith "^") | :m / | m | keys | sort * (:k / | :v (m | /k) | [k v] | join "@")

H4: filter ~/state | eq "open" | * (at :assignee | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") | groupBy ~/ | * count

H5: :config / | config | /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq false | not) | sort ~/name | * {:name /name :timeout (/timeout | if (type | eq ::null) ~(config | /defaults | /timeout) ~(/)) :retries (/retries | if (type | eq ::null) ~(config | /defaults | /retries) ~(/))}

H6: filter ~(at :durationMs | type | ne ::null) | groupBy ~/service | * (* /durationMs | :durations / | (durations | sum) | div ~(durations | count) | round 1)

H7: filter ~(:s /stock | if (s | type | eq ::number) ~(s | gt 0) ~(false)) | sort ~/price | reverse | take 3 | * /name

H8: groupBy ~/dept | * (* (at :skills | coalesce []) | flat | * lower | distinct | sort)

H9: filter ~(/role | lower | eq "db") | every ~((/region | eq "eu-west") | and ~((/cpu/cores | gte 8)))

H10: split ";" | * (split ",") | flat | * (split " " | filter ~(ne "") | join "" | split "@" | last | lower) | distinct | sort

H11: lines | * (split " " | {:path /2 :status /3}) | filter ~(/status | startsWith "5") | groupBy ~/path | * count | :counts / | counts | keys * {:path / :count (counts | at /)} | sort ~/path | sort ~/count | reverse | take 2

H12: lines | * (split ",") | drop 1 | filter ~((at 2 | ne "")) | * {:team /1 :score (/2 | parseJson)} | groupBy ~/team | * (* /score | :scores / | (scores | sum) | div ~(scores | count) | round 2)

H13: lines | filter ~(ne "") | filter ~(startsWith "#" | not) | filter ~(contains "==") | * (split "==" | "\"" append (/0 | lower) append "\": " append (/1)) | join "," | "{ " append . append " }" | parseJson

H14: sort ~((at :comments | coalesce []) | * (at :likes | coalesce 0) | sum) | last | /title
